column2: Oh my! What a handsome man!!
Welcome to $$欲情$$ City, $$ベギルド$$! Make yourselves at home!
Welcome! I've got all sorts of fine goods in stock!
Oh my, you look very strong!
Oh no! To think there is a man in this city who does not know me!
Welcome to $$ベギルド$$. Do you find our city to your liking?
If you like it, you are welcome to make your home here.
If you are strong... heehee! I do not care what color your $$羽$$ are...
After all, this is a wonderful city of $$欲情$$...
What? I have not done anything wrong... probably.
After all, only women work in this city... or perhaps not!?
It seems Lord $$グザファン$$'s private army marched off somewhere recently,
but I wonder what has happened since then?
Oh, you cannot come to this city and not stop by my place!
